name: pricing-frequency-toggle
title: Pricing Frequency Toggle
description: A three-tier pricing block: a centred heading, a small sliding monthly or yearly switch, and three plan cards whose prices animate to the new figure while percentage-off badges pop in for yearly billing.
use: A SaaS marketing page needs three tiers and a clear monthly versus yearly comparison.
avoid: Plan names, prices and features are hardcoded in the file, so real plans mean editing the source array.
a11y: The switch is labelled and exposes its pressed state, but the feature ticks are bare icons and the switch buttons use default focus styling. (keyboard: yes, labels: partial, reduced motion: respected)
looks: A centred heading and a line of grey subtext sit above a small two-option pill switch. Under them are three thin-bordered dark cards, the middle one slightly larger with a Popular badge, each holding a plan name, a big price, a billed label and a list of ticked features.
behaves: Clicking monthly or yearly slides a small light highlight between the two labels. The prices roll digit by digit to the new amount, and in the yearly view a discount percentage fades in at the top-right of each card, then out again when you switch back.
customise: The three plans, their monthly and yearly prices, features and button labels live in the plans array. Currency is fixed to USD, so other markets need a source edit.
weight: light: Three static cards plus a sliding highlight and digit transitions only when billing changes.
